finalText:
Found it: `src/core/settings.js` referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, so the linker crashed while computing `maxRetries` and aborted the whole build.

I fixed it to fall back to a real default (`DEFAULTS.maxRetries = 3`) when the caller doesn't pass one. The three warnings you saw were just noise (deprecated API, unused export, circular import) — none of those were the actual failure.

`node build.js` now finishes clean: exit code 0, still 3 warnings but 0 errors.
